events.description: Before the backdrop closes. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
events.name: ok:backdrop:beforeclose

events.description: Before the backdrop opens. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it closed.
events.name: ok:backdrop:beforeopen

methods.description: Hides it. Returns `false` if `ok:backdrop:beforeclose` was prevented.
methods.name: close

methods.description: Shows the backdrop. Returns `false` if `ok:backdrop:beforeopen` was prevented.
methods.name: open

options.description: Transparent: blocks clicks without dimming the page (for example, behind a custom menu).
options.name: invisible

options.description: Length of the fade in and out (ms). Default: the theme's durations.
options.name: transitionDuration

options.description: Open state (`open`; HTML: `data-ok-open`, a trigger or `open()`).
options.name: open

parts.description: Closes the backdrop whose `id` it names, or, without a value, the backdrop it sits in.
parts.name: data-ok-backdrop-close

parts.description: Opens the backdrop whose `id` it names.
parts.name: data-ok-backdrop-open

react.description: A fixed layer over the viewport. It reports nothing itself: close it from your own handler (for example, `onClick`) or when work ends.

props.description: Content shown in front of the page, centered (for example, a `CircularProgress`).
props.name: children

props.description: Transparent: blocks clicks without dimming the page.
props.name: invisible

props.description: Shows the backdrop (it fades in and out; closed, it stays in the DOM, hidden).
props.name: open

props.description: Length of the fade in and out, in ms. Default: the theme's durations.
props.name: transitionDuration
